_ndfd_maps: Snowfall (next snow_hours) and 24-h max wind / gust maps from NDFD GRIB2. Needs: pip install eccodes numpy. Snow map is skipped when no snow is forecast.
_alert_counties: FIPS codes of the localities you cover; alerts touching none of these are ignored. Empty list = every alert in alert_states.
_extended_rainfall: NDFD rainfall amounts stop ~72 h out. true = fill later days with NBM guidance (Open-Meteo, no key); those bars are marked as model guidance.
_outlooks: SPC Day 1 is always drawn; other days are skipped when there's no risk area on the map.
_formats: wide = 1920x1080 (TV/OBS/YouTube, top of output folder); vertical = 1080x1920 (Stories/Reels/TikTok) in output/.../vertical; post = 1080x1350 (Facebook/Instagram feed, 4:5) in output/.../post; square = 1080x1080 (1:1, Facebook/Instagram square) in output/.../square
_tide_flood_stages: Used only if the NWS gauge's official stages can't be fetched (ft MLLW).
_tide_sites: High tide graphic sites. 'nwps' = NWS gauge ID (official forecast + flood stages); 'search' finds the gauge ID by name automatically (run --outlook-debug to see what it found, then pin it as nwps); 'coops' = NOAA tide station used as a backup (astronomical tide).
_dma_counties: Hampton Roads DMA counties/cities (FIPS), outlined on the statewide rainfall map.
_qpf_maps: WPC rainfall maps to make (days). Each gets a Hampton Roads map and, with qpf_state_map, a Virginia & North Carolina map.
_winter_maps: WPC snow/ice probability maps (chance of 4", 8", 12" snow and 0.25" ice, Days 1-3) and Winter Storm Severity Index maps. Maps with nothing in the area are skipped (winter_always: true makes them anyway). winter_state_map adds a Virginia & North Carolina version of each.
_cli_today_after_hour: From this hour on (local), the climate graphics use today's afternoon NWS climate report so they include today. Before then (or until that report is out) they use yesterday's complete report.
_cpc_hazards: CPC U.S. Hazards Outlook on an eastern U.S. map (Great Lakes to the Gulf): one graphic for all hazards and a separate heavy rain / flooding graphic. cpc_periods: '8-14' (and '3-7' when CPC's map service has it). The Days 8-14 hazards map is always made (cpc_show_empty); the heavy rain map only when there's a rain area (cpc_rain_always forces it).
_tide_sites_2: Sites for the second high tide graphic (high_tides_2.png). Same fields as tide_sites.
_aqi_area: AirNow reporting area for the air quality graphic (official current AQI + state forecast; no key). If it isn't found, the nearest reporting area is used. Days without an official forecast use CAMS model guidance (Open-Meteo), marked with *.
_river_flooding: NWS river forecast points. Graphics are ONLY exported when a gauge's forecast reaches river_min_category (action stage) or higher: a summary list (river_flooding.png) plus one hydrograph per gauge (river_1.png, river_2.png ... in output/latest).
_tidal_flood_map: Map of the bay, rivers and shoreline shaded by forecast tidal flood category for each high tide that reaches tidal_map_min_category. Built from the NWS tide gauge forecasts (tide_sites + tide_sites_2 + tidal_map_sites), each gauge scored on its own flood stages and blended between gauges (inverse-distance), carried out to tidal_radius_km from the nearest gauge.
_warm_departure_min: Above-average graphic: days whose forecast high is at least this many degrees above the 1991-2020 average high. One day = single-day spotlight; several = warm stretch. No warm days = no graphic.
_holidays: Holiday countdown: holiday_count = how many to show (1 spotlight + the rest listed). holidays_off = names to skip, e.g. ["Valentine's Day"]. holidays_extra = your own, e.g. {"name": "Hanukkah", "date": "2026-12-04", "icon": "1f54e"} or a yearly {"name": "Harborfest", "date": "06-12", "icon": "1f389"}. Icons: any code in wxgfx/data/holiday_icons.
_drought: Drought Monitor (full-screen map of VA & NC from the weekly U.S. Drought Monitor) with Norfolk's drought category and rainfall vs normal for the last 30/60/90 days and since Jan 1 (ACIS, ORFthr).
_fullscreen_maps: Also make a full-screen version (map fills the image, info bars along the bottom) of every map graphic, saved as <name>_full.png. fullscreen_local_view = [w, e, s, n] zoom for the local maps.
_ffg: Flash Flood Guidance maps (ffg_1hr, ffg_3hr, ffg_6hr + _full versions): rain needed in that many hours to start flooding small streams, from the NWS River Forecast Centers' hourly gridded FFG. ffg_hours can include 1, 3, 6, 12, 24.
_reports: Observed reports: rain_reports = CoCoRaHS 24-hour totals (made when someone reports rain_reports_min or more); storm_snow/rain/wind_reports = NWS Wakefield Local Storm Reports + Public Information Statements from the last storm_reports_hours (made only when there are reports).
_tropical_pack: Hurricane-threat graphics, saved to output/.../Tropical/ (+ vertical/post/square inside it). Only made while a storm threatens: cone over Norfolk, 34-kt wind chance >= tropical_min_prob, NWS Wakefield hurricane statements, or the track within tropical_threat_miles. tropical_always: true makes them for any active Atlantic storm. Evacuations / outages / checklist can be typed into overrides.json under "tropical".
_bigtext: Big-text social twins (<name>_big.png) of every map: giant headline, value callouts on the map, caption box, tagline banner, logo. Text options: overrides.json -> bigtext (see README).
_frost_risk: Frost & freeze risk: table of forecast lows + risk by location for the next frost_nights nights, plus a risk map per night with frost. NDFD lows adjusted for wind/cloud. Only made when frost is possible (frost_always forces it).
_output_layout: "category" = output/latest_rickywx/<NN Category>/ (wide graphics) + Vertical/ Post/ Square/ inside  (01 Forecast, 02 Severe & Alerts, 03 Temperature, 04 Rain & Flooding, 05 Snow & Ice, 06 Wind, 07 Tides & Coast, 08 Tropical, 09 Long Range, 10 Climate & Drought, 11 Air Quality & Sun, 12 Aviation). "flat" = the old layout (wide at the top, vertical/ post/ square/ Tropical/).
_latest_folder: Name of the always-current folder inside output/ (OBS, phone page and Drive use it). An old output/latest is moved here automatically.
_keep_days: Dated run folders in output/ older than this many days are deleted after each run (0 = keep everything). latest_rickywx is never touched.
_sound_flood: Sound-side flooding (Sandbridge, Back Bay, Knotts Island, Carova) from a long south wind pushing Currituck Sound water north. Made when the wind blows from between sound_dirs (degrees) at sound_wind_min mph or more for sound_min_hours hours or more within the next sound_hours. sound_point = where the wind forecast is taken (over Back Bay). sound_lag_hours = how long water stays high after the wind.
_tide_hours_fallback: The Sewells Point tide chart runs exactly through the end of the official NWS forecast (water.noaa.gov SWPV2), nothing beyond it. Only if the NWS forecast is unavailable does it show this many hours of predicted tide instead.
